remarks: Bright, two-level townhouse-style condo in the heart of Stamford! This 2BR/2.5BA home blends space, light, and convenience just steps from Downtown and Bedford Street's shops, dining, and nightlife. The main level features an open living/dining area with a wood-burning fireplace, a sunny balcony for morning coffee, and a spacious kitchen with great storage. An in-unit laundry and a convenient powder room make everyday living easy.  Upstairs, the private bedroom level includes a primary suite with vaulted ceiling, walk-in closet, and full bath, plus a well-sized second bedroom and hall bath-perfect for guests, a roommate, or a home office. One reserved off-street parking space in the complex lot is included (visitor parking per association rules).  Minutes to the Stamford Train Station (Metro-North) and I-95 for an effortless commute. Fresh, bright, and move-in ready-enjoy comfortable living with all of Stamford at your doorstep.
